calculation.moment_scope: Prior one-step scale and empirical squared residual use the SAME actually visible targets and four cosine/sine coordinates. Returning-observation subset is prior error BEFORE correction, distinct from primary recovery AFTER correction. Ratio of means is descriptive, not coverage or conditional calibration.
calculation.one_step: Saved one_step_mean at action t compared with publicpacket t+1 on valid targets only; mean over4coordinates. Rewards compared overall50 issued actions.
calculation.percent_effect: 100*(control-normalized)/control; positive means lower MSE. Learning is100*(initial-final)/initial.
calculation.primary: For each episode, detect actual packet validity0-to1 transitions. Require exactly2 returning roots with complete H5 window and valid h1,h3 endpoints. Independently calculate squared open_loop_mean[e,root,h-1,:] minus public packets[e,root+h,:4], mean over4coordinates then2horizons and2roots. Mean equally over128episodes then3fits. Saved masks/errors and audit functions are not used.

gate.interpretation: All4 family superiority checks miss the required3% recovery improvement. Pair0 is worse than both age/raw in each panel; the other8 paired nonworse checks pass. Constant-family, one-step-regression and all3 own-initial-learning checks pass.

limits: All development episodes come from the original training corpus; ten-gap inputs censor additional previously visible packets on the same off-policy trajectories, not a fresh native rollout.
Three fits are descriptive paired replicates. No significance test, new bootstrap draw, fit selection, early stopping or posthoc threshold change was performed.

Residual scale head estimates bounded per-coordinate residual second moments, including mean bias; it is not a standard deviation, full covariance or Gaussian coverage claim on the cosine/sine manifold.
All normalized visible-target bound-hit fractions are zero; this rules out direct saturation at the declared bounds in these predictions, not underfitting or optimization limitations.

Predicted scales fell from initialization, but these saved outputs alone cannot determine whether variance-head parameters changed, establish convergence, or show that scale error caused the primary gate result.
No gradients, Adam transitions or numerical neural forwards were replayed. All scientific inputs remain unchanged; only the review JSON is new.
reportable_claims: All12 fits and48 initial/final development evaluations completed in one recorded attempt. Independent saved-output audit passed completeness; the prospective development continuation gate FAILED21/29.
All four gate families learned much better recovery predictions than their own initializations, but normalized gating did not establish the specified improvement over simpler gates.
Normalized family recovery advantages over age/raw are tiny (under0.13% in both panels), not the required3%, and pair0 is slightly worse in both comparisons and panels.

The predicted diagonal residual scales substantially exceed empirical squared residuals on the same visible-target development samples. This is observable marginal scale overprediction; it does not identify the cause of the failed gate or establish conditional calibration.
No current finding establishes native control improvement, untouched-test performance, biological or Bayesian superiority, or an ICLR novelty claim.
scope: Independent saved-output development result review; no learned inference, training, optimizer or native calls
